title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**overview**
------------

at ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. make your move.

* job type: full time
* work type: hybrid

  

we made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. you'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. at ford, you can build more than vehicles. come build what matters.

**enterprise technology** plays a critical part in shaping the future of mobility. if you’re looking for the chance to leverage advanced technology to redefine the transportation landscape, enhance the customer experience and improve people’s lives, this is the opportunity for you. join us and challenge your it expertise and analytical skills to help create vehicles that are as smart as you are.

**in this position...**

the order fulfillment technology team is seeking a **senior ai engineer** to design, build, deploy, and operate production-grade ai solutions supporting forecasting, planning, and scheduling. you'll build retrieval-augmented generation applications and controlled ai agents that generate grounded recommendations and automation with human oversight. this is a hands-on role for someone who can move ai solutions beyond prototypes into secure, scalable, and trustworthy production services.

**what you'll do...**

* ai application development: design and build production-grade llm applications, rag solutions, and tool-using ai agents to improve decision speed, accuracy, and transparency.
* retrieval pipelines: build retrieval pipelines covering ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, grounding, and citations, producing recommendations that are traceable and earn user trust.
* engineering & deployment: develop maintainable python services, apis, and reusable ai components; deploy and operate them using automated testing, ci/cd, containerization, logging, and monitoring.
* evaluation & monitoring: create evaluation datasets and automated tests measuring task success, groundedness, safety, latency, and cost; monitor production for drift, failures, and cost anomalies.
* responsible ai & governance: apply responsible controls throughout the development lifecycle, exercising sound judgment on when generative ai is warranted versus a simpler, deterministic solution.
* stakeholder partnership: partner with product, software engineering, data science, and data engineering to bring ai solutions from concept to production.
* user engagement: spend time directly with planners, schedulers, and other end users to understand real workflows and pain points, ensuring ai solutions are grounded in how decisions are actually made.
* continuous improvement: evaluate emerging ai technologies based on measurable business value, quality, and cost. establish reusable patterns the wider team can build on.

**you'll have...**

* education: bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, data science, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* technical experience: 5+ years in software engineering, ml engineering, or applied ai, including hands-on python, sql, and experience building or deploying llm/agent-based applications (e.g., prompt engineering, fine-tuning, rag, or frameworks such as langchain, langgraph, autogen, semantic kernel).
* software engineering practices: experience developing maintainable production services/apis, with working knowledge of automated testing, git workflows, code reviews, ci/cd, and containerization.
* evaluation discipline: experience defining measurable quality criteria and evaluating ai/ml systems using quantitative metrics and structured human review.
* collaborative delivery: proven ability to work with software engineering teams and business users to move solutions from concept to production.
* user-centered practice: demonstrated experience engaging directly with end users to shape and validate ai solutions.
* communication: proven ability to translate ambiguous business problems into technical solutions and interpret results for non-technical partners.

**even better, you may have...**

* advanced degree: master's degree or phd in a quantitative or technical field.
* technical domain expertise: llm application architectures (rag, tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, memory management) and retrieval pipeline design (embeddings, chunking, hybrid search, reranking).
* agent control & orchestration: structured outputs, workflow orchestration, agent state management, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* production experience: deploying and maintaining llm/agent systems in production, including prompt versioning and ci/cd integration.
* ai observability: implementing logging, tracing, dashboards, and cost/latency monitoring for model or agent behavior.
* security & adversarial testing: testing for prompt injection, data leakage, unsafe tool execution, or unauthorized access.
* cloud & model infrastructure: deploying llm/agent solutions in a cloud environment (gcp preferred), with familiarity with vector databases and model hosting.
* industry context: familiarity with automotive oem data, dealer relationships, or supply chain logistics.

you may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to ford motor company, we encourage you to apply!

as an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. you can choose what your ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? no matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

* immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
  + flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more
  + family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more
  + vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases
  + tuition assistance
  + established and active employee resource groups
  + paid time off for individual and team community service
  + a generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between christmas and new year’s day
  + paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

title: Sr. Data Scientist (Forecasting)
description:
as the digital arm for the world's largest food and beverage company, nestlé it & digital americas harnesses the power of data, analytics, and innovative technology to deliver transformative solutions and business resiliency for nestlé businesses and iconic brands from purina® to nescafé®. we’re innovators, strategic collaborators, value multipliers, and digital business leaders committed to delivering results that create meaningful experiences and drive value, enabling nestlé to win in the marketplace. by joining, you become part of a 150-year legacy and a global team of 270,000+. we invest in our people—their growth, development, and sense of belonging. this shared unity and purpose is what motivates individuals to join, stay, and advance their careers within nestlé.

*this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.*

**position summary**

join nestlé it & digital as a sr. data scientist supporting nestlé usa digital, where you'll partner with the supply chain planning team and the analytics team to build the forecasting solutions that power how nestlé usa plans and operates at scale. you'll design and deploy production-grade forecasting models, embed ai into how forecasts get delivered, and serve as a key liaison between the technical and functional sides of enterprise forecasting. you'll bring a strong ai mindset, curiosity about emerging technologies, and comfort operating in ambiguity as the forecasting landscape evolves.

  

* design, develop, test, and deploy statistical and machine learning forecasting models in production on cloud-based analytics platforms, with a focus on demand pattern recognition, algorithm selection, outlier correction, and parameter optimization to drive forecast accuracy and bias reduction
* build and maintain structured, programmatic forecasting processes that deliver at scale, leveraging ml ops practices to automate weekly forecast generation and reduce manual effort
* embed agentic ai and genai capabilities into forecasting workflows to identify accuracy improvement opportunities, automate root cause analysis, and support insights generation and decision-making
* continuously explore and apply emerging ai/ml techniques such as deep learning and probabilistic forecasting to improve forecast accuracy and scalability across a complex portfolio of skus, clusters, and data sources
* serve as a liaison between technical and functional teams, partnering with supply chain planning leads and cross-functional stakeholders across marketing, finance, and sales to align business needs with system and process solutions
* advance enterprise forecasting as part of the one planning initiative and support customer order fulfilment improvements, enabling standardized, scalable, and cross-functional forecasting solutions across the organization
* deliver training and forecast office hours to supply chain planning users to build analytics literacy, promote adoption, and increase enterprise value
* create and enhance power bi reports for forecast kpi monitoring and data validation, and present findings through data visualization and powerpoint tailored to the audience

**requirements**

* bachelor's degree in statistics, mathematics, economics, business, or a related field
* 5+ years of experience in data science, forecasting, or advanced analytics, with hands-on experience in sql, python, or a similar language
* 5+ years of experience extracting, transforming, and analyzing large datasets, and creating data visualizations to communicate insights
* 3+ years of experience deploying and maintaining machine learning models in production, including regression, classification, time series modeling, and feature engineering

**other**

* master's degree in statistics, mathematics, economics, business, or a related discipline is preferred
* experience with ml ops practices, cloud and ai/ml platforms (databricks, snowflake, microsoft azure), genai solutions, and microsoft power bi is preferred
* experience supporting enterprise-scale transformation or supply chain planning initiatives in an agile environment is preferred

title: AI Solutions Developer
description:
*about anthony & sylvan*

looking to build something that lasts—literally? at anthony & sylvan pools, your skills create real impact. for nearly 80 years, we’ve been turning backyard dreams into reality as the nation’s largest and most recognizable name in swimming pools. founded in 1946, we design and build quality inground pools across the u.s., while also offering renovations, modernizations, and ongoing maintenance services. we’re growing fast and seeking candidates who take pride in craftsmanship, value teamwork and safety, and are ready to grow with us. learn more at anthonysylvan.com.

*about the role*

anthony & sylvan pools is seeking an **ai solutions developer** to join our technology team and help build the next generation of ai-enabled business solutions.

this role is designed for an early-career technologist with strong programming skills and hands-on experience building with artificial intelligence. we are particularly interested in recent graduates who have developed meaningful technical experience through internships, co-ops, research, capstone projects, or substantial independent projects.

***general summary of position***

this is not a traditional entry-level development role focused on maintaining existing applications. you will have the opportunity to work directly on real business problems and build ai-powered applications, agents, automations, and integrations that are put into production and used across the company.

the ideal candidate enjoys experimenting with emerging technology, learns quickly, and is equally interested in understanding **what problem should be solved** as they are in writing the code to solve it.

***essential functions and responsibilities***

* **design, develop, and implement ai-powered applications, agents, workflows, and intelligent automations** that address real business needs and improve customer experience, employee productivity, and operational efficiency.
* **partner with business and technology teams to understand processes and requirements**, identify opportunities for ai and automation, rapidly prototype potential solutions, and develop successful concepts into scalable, production-ready applications.
* **develop ai-enabled applications using python and other modern development technologies**, leveraging large language models (llms), generative ai platforms, apis, ai development frameworks, and structured and unstructured data.
* **build agentic and intelligent workflows** using techniques such as prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (rag), tool/function calling, and ai orchestration to enable solutions that can reason, take actions, interact with systems, and automate multi-step business processes.
* **integrate ai applications with enterprise systems and data sources** including crm, erp, data and communication platforms, and other business applications by building and consuming rest apis, web services, and related integrations.
* **support the full solution development lifecycle** including solution design, testing, deployment, monitoring, evaluation, and continuous improvement, with a focus on improving ai output reliability, accuracy, performance, scalability, and user experience.
* **explore emerging ai technologies and development approaches** to identify practical business applications, while maintaining clear technical documentation, sharing knowledge with the technology team, and contributing to the continuous improvement of ai development practices.
* other duties as assigned

***qualifications – knowledge, skills & abilitie***s

**education**

bachelor’s degree in artificial intelligence, computer science, software engineering, data science, information sciences & technology, computer engineering, or a related technical discipline

**licenses/certifications**

none required

**years of experience**

demonstrated hands-on experience developing ai, machine learning, or software solutions. relevant experience may include professional roles, internships, co-ops, research, capstone projects, freelance development, open-source contributions, hackathons, or substantial independent projects. demonstrated capability and quality of work are valued over a specific number of years of experience.

**required skills & abilities**

strong programming skills, particularly in **python**; experience with javascript, typescript, c#, or similar languages is valuable

hands-on experience developing ai or machine learning solutions and working with modern generative ai models and apis

strong understanding of software development fundamentals, data structures, apis, databases, and application architecture

familiarity with sql and structured data

strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to quickly learn and apply new technologies

ability to communicate technical concepts effectively and collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

curious, experimental mindset with a willingness to iterate, test new approaches, and challenge traditional solutions

experience with one or more of the following preferred: llm platforms (openai, azure openai, anthropic, google gemini); agentic ai and multi-step workflows; rag, embeddings, vector databases, or semantic search; ai evaluation, guardrails, observability, or responsible ai practices; api development and systems integration

experience with cloud and development technologies such as microsoft azure, microsoft fabric, github, github copilot, data engineering, or analytics platforms preferred

exposure to crm, erp, contact center, workflow automation, or other enterprise business applications preferred

demonstrated experience building and deploying complete applications or technical solutions beyond basic classroom assignments preferred

n/a or as needed

candidates are encouraged to provide examples of technical work, such as a github repository, portfolio, capstone project, ai agent, application, research project, hackathon submission, or other relevant project.

* primarily sedentary work performed in an office environment
* ability to communicate promptly and clearly via phone and computer

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
onemagnify is an ai native, platform-enabled b2b digital agency operating at the intersection of data, technology, and creativity. we help complex organizations drive measurable business outcomes by building smarter customer experiences and delivering highly integrated solutions across digital, media, and technology. by combining deep industry expertise with advanced analytics and artificial intelligence, we enable our clients to make better decisions, move faster, and compete more effectively in dynamic markets.

**role summary**

as a senior data engineer on our customer analytics team, you'll own the data foundation behind crm analytics, measurement, and data science work for major enterprise brands. you'll design and run production pipelines on google cloud and decide how data gets modeled, validated, and delivered. your work turns messy source data into something analysts, data scientists, and clients can trust. when our insights shape how a client spends its marketing budget, your pipelines are the reason those numbers hold up.

**the impact you'll have**

our clients are large, data-savvy organizations that expect every recommendation to come with proof. their crm programs, campaign measurement, and customer segmentation all depend on data you build and maintain. a late or broken feed means a wrong answer in a client meeting. a well-engineered one means faster decisions and measurable roi.

you'll work between data science, analytics, bi, and client teams. you'll be the person who turns a business question into a data design, and the one who keeps a platform running that serves every discipline on the account.

ai and ml work is moving from experimentation into production across our client environments. you'll help make that happen by building the data plumbing that lets models and agents run reliably inside gcp, instead of stalling in a notebook.

**what you'll do**

**build the pipelines that power client analytics**

* design, build, and maintain batch data pipelines on gcp using bigquery, dataform, cloud composer/airflow, and dataflow. take a sql-first approach and build to scale as client data grows.
* write and optimize complex sql that keeps bigquery fast and costs predictable.
* build external data api integrations on cloud run to bring third-party and platform data into a single, usable environment.

**own data quality end to end**

* own the validation and cleansing pipelines that catch data problems before they reach a dashboard, a model, or a client.
* troubleshoot pipeline failures quickly, including tracing issues upstream, and fix root causes so the same failure doesn't come back.

**fuel data science and analytics**

* partner with data scientists and analysts to deliver reliable, well-documented datasets that shorten the path from question to insight.
* work with the data science team on ai/ml integrations in gcp so models can move into production workflows.

**translate business questions into data solutions**

* lead requirements conversations with client and internal stakeholders, and turn loosely defined asks into clear data designs.
* build and maintain dashboards and handle ad-hoc client data requests. where it makes sense, turn one-off requests into repeatable assets.

**engineer with discipline**

* use git, pull request workflows, and ci/cd automated deployments to ship changes safely and often.
* raise the team's engineering standards through code reviews and shared best practices.

**what you'll need**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 3+ years of data engineering experience, including production batch pipelines on gcp (bigquery, cloud composer/airflow, dataflow)
* advanced sql skills, with experience building sql-first pipelines in bigquery
* strong python skills
* experience building api integrations, ideally on cloud run
* hands-on experience with version control and ci/cd (git, pr workflows, automated deployments)
* ability to gather requirements from technical and non-technical stakeholders, and confidence working directly with clients
* the judgment to make design tradeoffs and explain them clearly

**future-ready skills (nice to have)**

* experience with dataform or dbt for modular, tested, version-controlled transformations
* experience building with gemini enterprise agents (formerly vertex ai)
* background in consumer or marketing data, such as crm, campaign response, or customer identity data
* experience using ai-assisted development tools to speed up pipeline builds, testing, and documentation

**benefits**

we believe great work happens when people have the support and flexibility they need to thrive. our benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) retirement plan, paid holidays, and flexible time off (fto) so you can take time away to recharge when you need it. we also offer additional programs focused on wellness, financial security, and professional growth.

**we are an equal opportunity employer**

we believe that innovative ideas and solutions start with unique perspectives. that's why we're committed to providing every employee a workplace that's free of discrimination and intolerance. we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and actively search for like-minded people to join our team.

we will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform job functions, and to receive benefits and privileges of employment. please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Databricks Engineer
description:
**title: databricks engineer**

**location: remote in usa**




working hours in est

**required certification: active databricks certified data engineer associate certification.**


**role summary**


the data engineer is responsible for building, maintaining, and supporting data solutions on the databricks data intelligence platform running on microsoft azure, aws or gcp. the role leverages databricks, python, pyspark, and sql to deliver data ingestion, transformation, modeling, and pipeline orchestration.


working within the standards and designs set with the senior data engineer, this role independently owns the delivery of assigned pipelines from development through production support.


**responsibilities**


* build and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines for extracting, transforming, and loading (etl/elt) data from multiple sources into the databricks lakehouse on azure.
* implement data ingestion using auto loader, lakeflow connect, and azure data factory.
* develop pipelines with lakeflow spark declarative pipelines (formerly delta live tables), including data quality expectations.
* perform data manipulation and transformation using pyspark and spark sql, ensuring data is prepared for analytics and reporting.
* configure, schedule, and monitor data workflows with lakeflow jobs (formerly databricks workflows).
* implement data models within the lakehouse following medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold) and team modeling standards.
* apply unity catalog permissions and governance standards to the data assets you build.
* write unit and data quality tests and deploy pipelines through ci/cd using git folders and declarative automation bundles (formerly databricks asset bundles).
* monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve pipeline failures and data quality issues in production.
* participate in code reviews and contribute to team documentation and engineering standards.
* collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including business stakeholders and it, to ensure data solutions meet business and performance requirements aligned to project goals.

**required qualifications**


**experience**


* 6\+ years of professional experience in data engineering, data \& analytics or data warehousing.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience working with databricks in a data engineering capacity.
* 3\+ years of experience with python, including manipulating large datasets using pyspark dataframes, spark sql, and/or the pandas api on spark.
* 2\+ years of data engineering experience on microsoft azure (e.g., adls gen2, azure data factory, key vault).

**skills and knowledge**


* proficiency in python programming for data engineering tasks.
* strong knowledge of sql for data modeling, transformation, and querying.
* working knowledge of delta lake fundamentals (e.g., merge, schema evolution, time travel).
* working knowledge of unity catalog concepts, including catalogs, schemas, and permissions.
* experience with git\-based version control and familiarity with ci/cd practices for data pipelines.
* understanding of testing and deployment strategies for data pipelines, including productionizing etl pipelines and databricks sql queries.

**education**


* bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data engineering, or a closely related field, or equivalent professional experience.

**preferred qualifications**


* experience implementing streaming data ingestion in databricks (structured streaming, auto loader, event hubs).
* experience with healthcare data (e.g., claims, ehr/clinical data, hl7/fhir) and hipaa/phi handling.
* exposure to spark and delta lake performance tuning and compute cost optimization.
* familiarity with dimensional modeling and scd type 1 and type 2 patterns.
* experience enabling bi consumption through databricks sql warehouses and tools such as power bi.

the base salary for this position is $92,250 to $120,000 plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays and paid learning days.

* experience implementing streaming data ingestion in databricks (structured streaming, auto loader, event hubs).

* exposure to spark and delta lake performance tuning and compute cost optimization.
* familiarity with dimensional modeling and scd type 1 and type 2 patterns.
* experience enabling bi consumption through databricks sql warehouses and tools such as power bi.

working hours in est

working within the standards and designs set with the senior data engineer, this role independently owns the delivery of assigned pipelines from development through production support.


**responsibilities**


* build and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines for extracting, transforming, and loading (etl/elt) data from multiple sources into the databricks lakehouse on azure.
* implement data ingestion using auto loader, lakeflow connect, and azure data factory.
* develop pipelines with lakeflow spark declarative pipelines (formerly delta live tables), including data quality expectations.
* perform data manipulation and transformation using pyspark and spark sql, ensuring data is prepared for analytics and reporting.
* configure, schedule, and monitor data workflows with lakeflow jobs (formerly databricks workflows).
* implement data models within the lakehouse following medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold) and team modeling standards.
* apply unity catalog permissions and governance standards to the data assets you build.
* write unit and data quality tests and deploy pipelines through ci/cd using git folders and declarative automation bundles (formerly databricks asset bundles).
* monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve pipeline failures and data quality issues in production.
* participate in code reviews and contribute to team documentation and engineering standards.
* collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including business stakeholders and it, to ensure data solutions meet business and performance requirements aligned to project goals.

**required qualifications**


**experience**


* 6\+ years of professional experience in data engineering, data \& analytics or data warehousing.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience working with databricks in a data engineering capacity.
* 3\+ years of experience with python, including manipulating large datasets using pyspark dataframes, spark sql, and/or the pandas api on spark.
* 2\+ years of data engineering experience on microsoft azure (e.g., adls gen2, azure data factory, key vault).

**skills and knowledge**


* proficiency in python programming for data engineering tasks.
* strong knowledge of sql for data modeling, transformation, and querying.
* working knowledge of delta lake fundamentals (e.g., merge, schema evolution, time travel).
* working knowledge of unity catalog concepts, including catalogs, schemas, and permissions.
* experience with git\-based version control and familiarity with ci/cd practices for data pipelines.
* understanding of testing and deployment strategies for data pipelines, including productionizing etl pipelines and databricks sql queries.

**education**


* bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data engineering, or a closely related field, or equivalent professional experience.

**preferred qualifications**


* experience implementing streaming data ingestion in databricks (structured streaming, auto loader, event hubs).
* experience with healthcare data (e.g., claims, ehr/clinical data, hl7/fhir) and hipaa/phi handling.
* exposure to spark and delta lake performance tuning and compute cost optimization.
* familiarity with dimensional modeling and scd type 1 and type 2 patterns.
* experience enabling bi consumption through databricks sql warehouses and tools such as power bi.

* experience implementing streaming data ingestion in databricks (structured streaming, auto loader, event hubs).

* exposure to spark and delta lake performance tuning and compute cost optimization.
* familiarity with dimensional modeling and scd type 1 and type 2 patterns.
* experience enabling bi consumption through databricks sql warehouses and tools such as power bi.

title: Databricks Engineer
description:

**location: remote in usa**




working hours in est

**role summary**


the data engineer is responsible for building, maintaining, and supporting data solutions on the databricks data intelligence platform running on microsoft azure, aws or gcp. the role leverages databricks, python, pyspark, and sql to deliver data ingestion, transformation, modeling, and pipeline orchestration.


working within the standards and designs set with the senior data engineer, this role independently owns the delivery of assigned pipelines from development through production support.


**responsibilities**


* build and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines for extracting, transforming, and loading (etl/elt) data from multiple sources into the databricks lakehouse on azure.
* implement data ingestion using auto loader, lakeflow connect, and azure data factory.
* develop pipelines with lakeflow spark declarative pipelines (formerly delta live tables), including data quality expectations.
* perform data manipulation and transformation using pyspark and spark sql, ensuring data is prepared for analytics and reporting.
* configure, schedule, and monitor data workflows with lakeflow jobs (formerly databricks workflows).
* implement data models within the lakehouse following medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold) and team modeling standards.
* apply unity catalog permissions and governance standards to the data assets you build.
* write unit and data quality tests and deploy pipelines through ci/cd using git folders and declarative automation bundles (formerly databricks asset bundles).
* monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve pipeline failures and data quality issues in production.
* participate in code reviews and contribute to team documentation and engineering standards.
* collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including business stakeholders and it, to ensure data solutions meet business and performance requirements aligned to project goals.

**required qualifications**


**experience**


* 6\+ years of professional experience in data engineering, data \& analytics or data warehousing.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience working with databricks in a data engineering capacity.
* 3\+ years of experience with python, including manipulating large datasets using pyspark dataframes, spark sql, and/or the pandas api on spark.
* 2\+ years of data engineering experience on microsoft azure (e.g., adls gen2, azure data factory, key vault).

**skills and knowledge**


* proficiency in python programming for data engineering tasks.
* strong knowledge of sql for data modeling, transformation, and querying.
* working knowledge of delta lake fundamentals (e.g., merge, schema evolution, time travel).
* working knowledge of unity catalog concepts, including catalogs, schemas, and permissions.
* experience with git\-based version control and familiarity with ci/cd practices for data pipelines.
* understanding of testing and deployment strategies for data pipelines, including productionizing etl pipelines and databricks sql queries.

**education**


* bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data engineering, or a closely related field, or equivalent professional experience.

**preferred qualifications**


* experience implementing streaming data ingestion in databricks (structured streaming, auto loader, event hubs).
* experience with healthcare data (e.g., claims, ehr/clinical data, hl7/fhir) and hipaa/phi handling.
* exposure to spark and delta lake performance tuning and compute cost optimization.
* familiarity with dimensional modeling and scd type 1 and type 2 patterns.
* experience enabling bi consumption through databricks sql warehouses and tools such as power bi.

title: Technical Solutions & Implementation Specialist
description:
bizzaly helps small businesses make technology and ai work for them, without the jargon. we work with local businesses to assess their technology, select the right tools, automate routine work, and implement practical ai and software solutions.

our clients include businesses in construction, real estate, professional services, and other industries across the bay area.

the role

we're looking for a hands-on technical professional who is comfortable working across small-business it, cloud applications, integrations, automation, and application support.

our team handles client relationships, business analysis, and strategy. you'll help turn those recommendations into working solutions.

this is not purely a help-desk role. in addition to supporting client technology, you'll help maintain and troubleshoot bizzaly's own client-facing applications and integrations.

what you'll do

* set up and administer google workspace, microsoft 365, cloud storage, backups, password managers, and other business tools
* migrate email, files, users, and accounts between systems
* configure and troubleshoot saas applications
* connect accounting, crm, scheduling, project-management, and other business systems through apis and integration tools
* set up ai tools and build practical automations using platforms such as zapier or make
* troubleshoot integrations, data flows, apis, and existing web applications
* help maintain and support bizzaly-developed client applications
* work with cloud environments, databases, git/github repositories, and deployment tools as needed
* diagnose basic network, server, security, and connectivity issues and identify when specialist support is required
* document systems, credentials, configurations, and processes clearly
* explain technology patiently and clearly to non-technical business owners

what we're looking for

* 4+ years of hands-on technology experience
* strong experience supporting small-business or business technology environments
* google workspace and/or microsoft 365 administration experience
* experience troubleshooting saas applications and integrations
* understanding of apis, databases, cloud infrastructure, and web applications
* strong security practices when handling client systems and data
* ability to independently investigate unfamiliar technology and solve problems
* excellent communication skills and patience with non-technical clients
* reliability and clear communication about timelines
* ability to occasionally visit client offices in the south bay

particularly valuable

you do not need every skill below, but experience in several would be valuable:

* aws, azure, or google cloud
* python and/or javascript
* react or other modern web frameworks
* sql and/or mongodb
* rest apis
* git/github
* docker and ci/cd
* quickbooks and accounting-system integrations
* zapier, make, n8n, or similar automation platforms
* ai apis and tools such as gemini, chatgpt, or claude
* crm platforms such as zoho, hubspot, or salesforce

the person we're looking for

you might currently be a systems engineer, application-support engineer, technical solutions engineer, full-stack developer with strong client skills, or an experienced it professional who has moved into cloud applications and automation.

we're less concerned with your title than with your ability to figure things out, implement solutions, and explain what you've done in plain english.

why work with us

* flexible part-time schedule
* variety: small-business technology, ai, automation, and application work
* direct interaction with business owners
* opportunity to help shape bizzaly's technical capabilities
* potential to grow into a larger technical role as bizzaly grows

pay: from $40.00 per hour

benefits:

* flexible schedule

work location: hybrid remote in sunnyvale, ca 94087

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
**your job**

the cloud engineer at kbx is an individual contributor responsible for operating, maintaining, and improving the cloud platform that supports our application teams. working with senior engineers and other team members, you will execute cloud infrastructure changes, fulfill platform and access requests, support shared services, troubleshoot issues, and help keep our aws environment secure, reliable, and supportable. this role is suited to someone early in their cloud engineering career who has strong technical fundamentals, follows established designs and standards, collaborates well, and can reliably carry work through implementation and operational support.

**our team**

we partner closely with software engineering and devops, security, and it leadership to create secure, scalable, and reliable platform solutions, strengthen engineering practices, and accelerate the responsible adoption of cloud and ai technologies. we value technical curiosity, critical thinking, knowledge sharing, technical leadership, and a "can-do" attitude.

**what you will do**

* build and support aws infrastructure using established designs, security controls, and change-management practices.
* work with senior engineers to clarify requirements and technical decisions.
* maintain, monitor, upgrade, and troubleshoot cloud platform technologies, including amazon eks, istio, solo gloo, kong, amazon msk/kafka, and redis/elasticache.
* use terraform, helm, and github actions to provision infrastructure and deploy platform changes.
* manage iam, access, networking, encryption, and secrets requests using established standards. identify automation opportunities and resolve security risks or unclear requirements with the team.
* monitor platform health, respond to alerts and incidents, troubleshoot issues with application teams, and escalate complex problems.
* apply tagging standards, support cost reporting, investigate waste, and implement approved cost-saving changes.
* investigate issues using documentation and operational data, ask for help when needed, and verify work before closing it.
* maintain implementation notes, runbooks, request records, and troubleshooting guides. share lessons with the team.
* build aws and cloud platform skills through hands-on work, training, certifications, and feedback.
* participate in the on-call rotation, respond to incidents, communicate impact, and help prevent repeat issues.

**who you are (basic qualifications)**

entry-level candidates are welcome. experience through employment, internships, labs, coursework, certifications, or personal projects involving aws, cloud infrastructure, systems administration, networking, software development, or devops

experience applying core aws concepts and services such as compute, networking, storage, iam, security groups, subnets, routing, and monitoring.

experience deploying, managing, or supporting containerized applications in kubernetes environments. familiarity with amazon eks, ingress controllers, container networking, or service mesh technologies is a plus.

experience scripting in python, powershell, or shell.

experience applying cloud security, identity and access management, monitoring, logging, incident response, and change-management best practices

an ability to use ai-assisted tools to support learning, scripting, analysis, documentation, troubleshooting, and operational workflows

**what will put you ahead**

* bachelor's degree in computer science or information technology field
* experience supporting cloud infrastructure, internal platforms, application teams, service requests, or operational queues in an internship, academic, lab, or professional setting
* experience using terraform, source control, or ci/cd automation
* experience working with amazon eks, ingress, container networking, or service mesh technologies is valuable but not required
* experience using service mesh technologies (istio or similar) and api gateway technologies such as gloo/kgateway, kong, or equivalent in a production setting
* using gitops methodologies and tools (argo cd) for continuous deployment on kubernetes
* experience with cloudflare or similar cdn/dns/web security platforms for cloud networking and traffic management
* experience working in a hybrid cloud or multi-cloud environments and integrating on-premises systems with aws cloud resources (networking, identity federation, etc.).
* aws certified solutions architect - associate, aws certified cloudops engineer - associate, or another relevant aws certification.
* certified kubernetes administrator (cka), hashicorp certified: terraform associate, or similar cloud/platform certification.

all koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. we are military ready and second chance employers. learn more about our hiring philosophy here .

kbx logistics, a koch company and global leader in transportation, offers world-class, technology-driven capabilities across all modes of managed freight and transportation asset management. kbx is uniquely positioned to meet the challenges shippers face, leveraging decades of firsthand experience and data-driven insights from a large, diverse, and global business network. by building mutually beneficial partnerships and innovative technology, kbx creates a competitive advantage for its customers and meets the growing need for cost effective and reliable supply chain solutions. for more information on kbx, visit www.kbx.com

at koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

**our benefits**

our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. we provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, add, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable summary plan description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. if you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.

you want more out of a career. a place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. at verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. we do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. our v team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. in crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. want in? join the #vteamlife.

### **what you’ll be doing...**

join verizon as we continue to grow our industry-leading network to improve the ways people, businesses, and things connect. within this broader mission of verizon, our team provides cutting-edge ai tooling and capabilities to empower over 15,000 developers across the enterprise. we are seeking a highly skilled and innovative ai engineer to focus on evaluating, fine-tuning, and deploying open-source models, llms, and foundational models, building agentic workflows, and integrating plugins and custom tools with developer platforms (such as github copilot, cursor, devin ai, and google antigravity) and our overall software development life cycle (sdlc). you will handle a wide variety of responsibilities pertaining to designing, building, and deploying ai solutions, agentic workflows, and mcp servers to improve developer productivity across verizon.key responsibilities include:

* mcp server & tool development: design, build, and deploy model context protocol (mcp) servers and tools to connect external apis, internal enterprise tools, and data sources with ai coding agents.
* agentic workflows: develop and fine-tune agentic workflows and multi-agent architectures (using frameworks such as langgraph or langchain) to automate developer and sdlc tasks.
* prompt & context engineering: apply advanced prompt design, context engineering, dynamic context injection, and hallucination mitigation strategies to maximize efficiency and accuracy.
* developer tool evaluation & integration: evaluate, test, and integrate ai developer tools (github copilot, cursor, devin ai, etc.) and ide extensions (e.g., vs code extensions) into the developer workflow.
* open-source & llm optimization: evaluate, fine-tune, optimize, and deploy open-source models and foundational llms tailored to enterprise needs and developer tools.
* rapid prototyping & research: conduct fast-paced research and experimentation on emerging genai tools, preview features, and frameworks to keep our internal tools ahead of industry standards.

### **what we’re looking for...**

you get excited by the possibilities that technology creates and how it can improve people’s lives. applying your analytical skills and expertise to solve complex problems is personally rewarding. no stranger to working in a fast-paced environment, you convey a sense of urgency and balance multiple opposing priorities with ease, never missing a deadline.

### **you’ll need to have:**

* bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. ·
* four or more years of of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
* experience in ai/ml software engineering, with deep proficiency in developing specialized frameworks.
* experience building mcp servers, tools, and integrations connecting llm agents to internal systems.
* knowledge of ide extension development (e.g., vs code extensions) and developer workflow automation within modern sdlc pipelines.
* experience with developer ai tools like github copilot, cursor, and devin ai.

### **even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* experience implementing evaluation metrics, monitoring, and tracing using tools.
* experience with open-source models, llms, and fine-tuning techniques .
* experience implementing rag pipelines, vector databases, and multi-agent frameworks (langchain, langgraph).
* knowledge of safety filtering, policy enforcement, and compliance governance for llm deployments .
* experience designing and deploying scalable cloud infrastructure on google cloud platform (gcp), utilizing key ai/ml services like vertex ai, gke, bigquery, and cloud run .
* active contributions to open-source agentic frameworks, mcp servers, or developer tooling ecosystems .

title: Shelton - Infrastructure - Engr- Dev Ops II
description:
**position summary**

the devops engineer is responsible for designing, building, and operating the continuous integration and delivery pipelines, infrastructure automation, and platform tooling that power subway’s technology organization. this role plays a critical part in enabling engineering teams to ship software faster, more reliably, and with greater confidence — while maintaining the security, stability, and scalability of shared delivery infrastructure.

the devops engineer brings a strong automation-first mindset and hands-on proficiency with modern ci/cd tooling, infrastructure-as-code, and cloud platforms. critically, this role is expected to actively leverage ai-powered tools and intelligent automation to accelerate delivery pipelines, reduce toil, improve system observability, and drive continuous improvement across the software delivery lifecycle.

**essential functions**

**ci/cd pipeline development & optimization**

* design, build, and maintain ci/cd pipelines that support rapid, reliable, and repeatable software delivery across multiple engineering teams
* automate build, test, packaging, and deployment workflows to minimize manual effort and human error
* integrate ai-assisted code quality, security scanning, and test coverage tools into pipeline stages to shift quality left
* monitor pipeline performance and health; identify and resolve bottlenecks that slow delivery velocity
* establish and enforce pipeline standards, branching strategies, and deployment patterns across the engineering organization

**infrastructure as code & cloud automation**

* develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code (iac) solutions using terraform and related tooling to provision, configure, and manage cloud and on-premises environments
* automate infrastructure lifecycle management — provisioning, scaling, patching, and decommissioning — to reduce manual operations overhead
* partner with cloud engineering to ensure iac modules meet architecture, security, and cost governance standards
* leverage ai-assisted code generation and iac validation tools to improve accuracy, consistency, and speed of infrastructure development
* maintain version-controlled infrastructure repositories with clear documentation and reusable module libraries

**ai & intelligent automation**

* actively identify and implement ai-powered tooling to automate repetitive devops tasks, including incident triage, change management, and environment provisioning
* leverage ai-assisted anomaly detection and predictive alerting to proactively surface issues before they impact delivery or production systems
* evaluate and integrate emerging ai developer tools — including ai coding assistants, automated testing frameworks, and intelligent observability platforms — into the devops toolchain
* contribute to the organization’s ai adoption journey by piloting new automation capabilities and documenting outcomes and best practices
* promote an automation-first culture within the engineering organization by sharing tools, patterns, and results with peers and stakeholders
* monitor cluster health, resource utilization, and workload performance; implement optimizations as needed

**platform reliability & incident management**

* monitor devops platform health, ci/cd infrastructure, and shared tooling to maintain high availability and performance
* respond to and resolve incidents affecting delivery pipelines, build infrastructure, or automation frameworks
* conduct root cause analysis on pipeline failures, environment issues, and recurring incidents; implement permanent fixes
* develop runbooks, playbooks, and self-healing automation to reduce mean time to recovery and minimize manual intervention
* partner with cloud engineering and observability teams to ensure end-to-end visibility across the delivery pipeline and supporting infrastructure

**devsecops & compliance**

* embed security practices throughout the ci/cd pipeline — including static code analysis, dependency scanning, secrets management, and image scanning
* partner with the cyber security team to ensure pipelines and automation frameworks meet enterprise security and compliance standards
* implement least-privilege access controls, audit logging, and policy-as-code across devops tooling and infrastructure
* support vulnerability remediation workflows by integrating security findings into developer feedback loops

**collaboration & engineering enablement**

* partner closely with application development, cloud engineering, and platform teams to understand delivery needs and continuously improve the devops toolchain
* provide technical guidance, documentation, and training to engineering teams on ci/cd best practices, automation patterns, and devops tooling
* participate in architecture reviews, sprint planning, and engineering discussions to contribute a devops and automation perspective
* share knowledge proactively — document patterns, publish runbooks, and contribute to the broader engineering community of practice

**skills and abilities required**

* strong hands-on experience with ci/cd platforms (e.g., github actions, azure devops, jenkins, or equivalent)
* proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tools, particularly terraform (required)
* demonstrated use of ai-powered developer tools and automation frameworks in a devops or engineering context
* solid understanding of cloud platforms (aws and/or azure); experience with multi-cloud environments a plus
* familiarity with scripting and automation languages such as python, bash, or powershell
* working knowledge of devsecops practices, including secrets management, vulnerability scanning, and policy-as-code
* strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a bias toward automation and elimination of toil
* effective communicator — able to explain technical concepts clearly to engineering peers and non-technical stakeholders

**education**

* bachelor’s degree required (computer science, information technology, engineering, or related field)
* relevant certifications preferred (e.g., aws/azure devops, cka/ckad, hashicorp terraform associate)

**experience**

* 4–7 years of hands-on devops, platform engineering, or site reliability engineering experience
* 3+ years building and maintaining ci/cd pipelines in an enterprise or cloud-native environment
* 3+ years writing and managing terraform modules for cloud or hybrid infrastructure
* demonstrated experience applying ai or automation tools to improve devops workflows, pipeline efficiency, or incident response
* experience working in an agile delivery environment with cross-functional engineering teams

**accountability / scope**

**people management:**

no

**direct reports:**

none

**scope:**

ci/cd pipelines, infrastructure automation, and devops toolchain

**decision making:**

individual contributor — technical design and implementation decisions within the devops engineering domain

**travel requirements**

* minimal (less than 5%)

description:
job description
  
  
position title
  
  
senior specialist, modeling & informatics
  
  
position description
  
  
we are seeking an exceptional and highly motivated informatician to join the cheminformatics group within modeling and informatics (m&i) at our our company. this role requires strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills and experience working in a cross-functional team environment. it involves both the development of innovative computational methods involving ai/ml and cheminformatics, as well as direct application of advanced computational approaches to the invention of novel medicines.
  
  
m&i is an inclusive team within our research & development division discovery chemistry organization, comprising approximately 50 computational chemists, cheminformaticians, and data scientists. we leverage cutting-edge capabilities in structure-based modeling, predictive science, and ai/ml to drive drug design and development globally, with a proven track record of pipeline impact. the selected candidate will work closely with the m&i team, our world-class chemistry teams, as well as cross-functionally with experimental and computational colleagues in the early target discovery space on innovative science that has a wealth of opportunities to impact drug discovery and ultimately save and improve patient lives.
  
  
**key responsibilities will include:**  

* implement and apply effective ai/ml and cheminformatics workflows to impact early target discovery space data analysis.
* analyze, interpret, and summarize complex chemical biology data and utilize a variety of data visualization tools to communicate findings.
* deliver optimized informatics algorithms and workflows to expedite drug discovery pipelines in the early target discovery space for small molecules, peptides, and targeted protein degraders.
* leverage novel ml, statistics, and cheminformatics techniques to improve hit identification for different screening paradigms.
* analyze and integrate internal and external knowledge to facilitate biological and chemical signature identification.
* proactively engage with cross-functional teams of experimental and computational scientists and collaborate effectively to advance project and pipeline goals
* continue research in areas of ai/ml and cheminformatics relevant to drug discovery, and evaluate new technology and software from commercial sources, open innovation, or external collaborations.
* effectively communicate scientific results internally and externally through presentations and publications.
* share ai/ml and/or data engineering knowledge to augment team skills and capabilities.

**position qualifications:**  
**education minimum requirement:**  
ph.d. in cheminformatics, bioinformatics, computational biology or chemistry, computer science, statistics or related fields
  
  
**required experience and skills:**  

* experience applying cheminformatics or ai/ml approaches to problem-solving in drug discovery.
* broad understanding of modern data science methods, particularly machine learning, e.g., predictive modeling, active learning, explainable ml.
* strong oral and written communication skills, as well as problem-solving skills.
* track record of scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals.
* proficiency in scripting (python and/or r), sql, and cheminformatics toolkits (oechem, rdkit, deepchem).

**preferred experience and skills:**  

* demonstrated ability to develop and apply ai/ml to problems of chemical or biological interest.
* experience with it infrastructure such as database systems, cloud computing (such as databricks, aws), and high-performance computing in linux environments.
* expertise in machine learning libraries (tensorflow, keras, pytorch, pandas, scikit-learn).
* experience with workflow applications and data analytics software (pipeline pilot, knime, spotfire).
* experience with high throughput screening data analysis methods.
* experience in chemical and biological signature identification and/or biomarker discovery.
* familiarity with or experience with multiple therapeutic modalities (small molecules, peptides, adcs, etc.)
* experience working in multidisciplinary teams that include experimental scientists.

**required skills:**  
academic research, algorithms, biological data analysis, biomarker discovery, biovia pipeline pilot, chemical informatics, computational biology, data analysis, data management, data modeling, data visualization, drug discovery research, knime, machine learning (ml), python (programming language), scientific research, scientific writing, tibco spotfire, virtual screening

title: AI Engineer I
description:
**location:** durham (hybrid)

**about us**

victra is verizon’s largest premium retailer in the united states. we thrive on collaboration, innovation, and performance. our mission is to “connect technology to life in a trustworthy, fun, and profitable way”. we work closely with verizon and our brand partners to deliver exceptional product offerings, promotions, and campaigns that drive in-store traffic and revenue.

**description**

victra is building its ai engineering capability in-house, and this role is where that starts. as an ai engineer i, you will build, test, and ship ai agents and workflows on microsoft copilot studio and azure ai foundry, working from specifications and architecture set by senior engineers. this is a deliberately early-career role: we are hiring for aptitude, curiosity, and builder instincts, not years of ai experience. no generative ai experience is required. if you are an early-career software developer, an automation or power platform builder ready to move into pro-code, a systems administrator, or an engineer excited to learn agent development on a funded, structured path, this role was written for you. you will have a named mentor, a certification budget, and real ownership of what you ship. our center of gravity is azure ai foundry, but the fundamentals you will learn here (apis, prompting, orchestration, evaluation) are platform-agnostic, and you will occasionally support builds beyond the core platforms, including open-source frameworks and ai coding tools.

**key responsibilities**

* build, test, and deploy ai agents and workflows on copilot studio and azure ai foundry, following the architecture standards and patterns set by senior engineers
* wire integrations between agents and business systems: connectors, apis, and tool integrations
* validate ai outputs against acceptance criteria; write and run tests, including basic evaluation checks, before anything ships
* troubleshoot edge cases and production issues with senior backup, and document root causes
* own one scoped agent after launch: monitoring, small fixes, and user feedback, with a named senior reviewer
* document every build to team standard so knowledge lives in the team, not one person's head
* support builds beyond the core platforms when directed, including open-source agent frameworks and ai coding tools, applying the same testing, documentation, and registration standards
* register everything you ship in the agent registry so nothing goes ungoverned
* complete the structured learning path (microsoft learn agent development curriculum plus funded certifications) on the agreed timeline

**what we are looking for**

**required**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, demonstrating technical dedication, the ability to commit long term, and a strong critical-thinking foundation
* demonstrated coding aptitude in a general-purpose programming language such as python, c#, or java; scripting experience (powershell, javascript, or power fx) also counts
* working knowledge of apis and data basics (calling a service, reading json, moving data between systems)
* defensive, edge-case thinking: you instinctively ask "what happens when this input is wrong"
* clear written communication and documentation habits
* evidence of self-driven learning: side projects, experiments, or a tool you taught yourself, including attempts that failed and what you did next
* comfortable using ai tools daily (claude, github copilot, or similar) as part of how you work
* no generative ai experience required; we will teach the ai

**preferred**

* a background that shows real building: software or application development, scripting, or automation engineering; power platform, rpa, servicenow, or systems administration experience is welcome as a starting point
* interest in pro-code building on azure: writing and consuming rest apis, azure functions (function apps), api management (apim), and retrieval-augmented generation (rag) work such as indexing and grounding strategies in azure ai foundry
* familiarity with a modern code workflow: git version control, branch management, and ci/cd pipelines for pushing code into production
* exposure to open-source agent frameworks or llm observability tooling (langchain, langfuse, or similar)
* microsoft certifications a plus, not a requirement: ai-901 or ab-900 (fundamentals), ab-620 ai agent builder associate, or ai-103 azure ai apps and agents developer associate; we fund certification for hires who do not have them
* retail or field operations exposure

**growth path**

* a published ladder from ai engineer i toward senior agent development, backed by funded certifications, a learning budget, and increasing ownership. first supervised production agent expected around month six; scoped independence grows from there.

**why join us?**

* paid training and career development opportunities.
* comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401k retirement plan.
* tuition reimbursement.
* employee discounts on verizon services.
* referral bonuses.
* career pathing opportunities.

**equal opportunity employer**

we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer - and celebrate our employees' differences, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. different makes us better.

title: AI ML Engineer
description:
overview  
we are seeking a dynamic and innovative ai machine learning (ml) engineer to join our cutting-edge technology team. in this role, you will drive the development, deployment, and optimization of advanced ai and ml models that power transformative data-driven solutions. your expertise will enable us to harness big data systems, natural language processing, predictive modeling, and generative ai to solve complex problems and deliver impactful insights. this position offers an exciting opportunity to work with state-of-the-art machine learning frameworks, cloud services, and scalable architectures in a fast-paced environment committed to technological excellence.

duties

* design, develop, and implement ai and machine learning models utilizing frameworks such as tensorflow, spark mllib, and other leading tools.
* conduct statistical analysis for research purposes, ensuring robust model evaluation and validation for accuracy and reliability.
* manage large-scale data pipelines using etl processes, hadoop, talend, and sql databases to prepare data for analysis and modeling.
* deploy ai models into production environments leveraging machine learning cloud services and scalable big data systems to ensure high performance and availability.
* collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate natural language processing (nlp), generative ai, and predictive analytics into business applications.
* optimize model training processes for efficiency and scalability while utilizing cloud platforms like aws for resource management.
* perform data mining and statistical modeling to uncover insights that inform strategic decision-making across various business units.

qualifications

* proven experience in developing machine learning models using frameworks such as tensorflow, r, python, or sas.
* strong understanding of big data systems including hadoop, spark implementation, and sql databases.
* hands-on experience with ai implementation in cloud environments like aws or similar platforms.
* proficiency in programming languages such as python, java, c, bash (unix shell), vba or related scripting languages.
* knowledge of data analytics tools like looker or similar bi platforms for visualization and reporting purposes.
* familiarity with database design principles, data mining techniques, and statistical analysis tools for research purposes.
* experience working with natural language processing (nlp), generative ai models, and predictive modeling analysis is highly desirable.
* ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple projects effectively.
